readback.name: Poincare.DeTurckCoupledForcing.exists_actual_coupled_forcing
readback.mathematical_statement: Let E be the fixed real three-dimensional Euclidean space ClosedSmoothModel 3, Bilin=E ->L[R] E ->L[R] R, and Jet1=E ->L[R] Bilin. For every universe u, let M : Type u have a topology, be Hausdorff, carry an E charted-space structure and the C-infinity IsManifold structure for closedSmoothModelWithCorners 3. Let g0,bg be any actual smooth positive-definite Riemannian metrics on M and anchor any point. There is no CompactSpace, connectedness, curvature, flow, limit, atlas, or supplied operator package premise. The pinned zone(anchor) is the genuine preferred chart target intersected with the locus where the fixed-anchor GeodesicTransport cutoff equals one on a full ambient E neighborhood. The pinned field0(z) is the actual zeroOrder coefficient built from the chart-metric pullback G of g0 with this exact model with corners, the background chart Christoffel field B of bg, and their actual spatial derivatives DB,DG,D2G. It retains inverse-metric variation against D2G and the metric partial derivative of the actual lowerTerm. field1(z) is the actual firstOrder coefficient from B,DB,G,DG, differentiating lowerTerm only in the metric first jet. raw0(a,b,c,d,z)=entryCLM c d (field0(z)(tensor a b)), and raw1(p,a,b,c,d,z)=entryCLM c d (field1(z)(firstJet p a b)). The elementary tensors and first jets use the actual Euclidean coordinate CLMs, retaining all nine ordered tensor slots and 27 ordered direction/tensor slots. Thus a,b are input tensor indices, p is the input derivative direction, and c,d are output tensor indices. entryCLM c d evaluates first at basis vector e_c and then e_d. The scalar coefficients are actual g0/bg coefficient evaluations, not free arrays replacing these fields. Fix an arbitrary total eta : E -> R, one output pair c,d, real alpha,T with 0 < alpha < 1 and 0 < T <= 1, and actual Y alpha T carrier arrays c0(a,b) and c1(p,a,b). The hypotheses require their exact realization on the entire time cylinder: c0(a,b)(t,z)=eta(z)*raw0(a,b,c,d,z) and c1(p,a,b)(t,z)=eta(z)*raw1(p,a,b,c,d,z) for every in-cylinder point. No smoothness, compact support, zone-support, range bound, or cutoff-one condition on eta is required in this constructor; the supplied carriers themselves already have the genuine Y boundedness and Hoelder structure. These realization inputs are the explicit output rows constructed by the extension theorem, not an assumed flow, derivative, coefficient-bound, or forcing-operator package. The theorem constructs K : Inputs alpha T ->L[R] Y alpha T R, where Inputs is the nine-component function space (Fin 3 times Fin 3) -> Graph alpha T with its original finite Pi maximum norm. Each Graph has its original sum norm of u,ut,du,ddu Y norms, zero initial u trace, and actual spatial/within-time derivative certificates. For every arbitrary input family W and every ambient q, (K W)(q) equals the pinned scalar value: sum over a,b of [c0(a,b)(q)*W(a,b).u(q) + sum over p of c1(p,a,b)(q)*W(a,b).du(q)(e_p)]. This is positive zero-order plus positive first-order coupling, with all nine inputs and all three spatial derivative directions included. The output is one scalar carrier for the fixed c,d pair, not a simultaneous nine-output tensor operator. Its operator norm is bounded by timeBound(c0,c1) = 24 * [N1*T^((1-alpha)/2) + N0*T^(1-alpha/2)], where N1=sum over a,b,p of norm(c1(p,a,b)) and N0=sum over a,b of norm(c0(a,b)). The powers are real powers and the two distinct exponents are retained. The bound uses the actual carrier norms, the original Graph norm and the original Pi maximum, with no norm replacement or supplied global constant. The constructor is quantified per alpha,T and carrier row; it does not itself choose one K or one numeric bound before all T. Combined with the extension's pre-time row constants it yields the corresponding uniform row estimate with N0<=C0,N1<=C1, but that combination is not a separate clause here. On every q in the cylinder, K W also equals eta(z)*entryCLM c d [field0(z)(tensorValue W q)+field1(z)(tensorJet W q)]. The actual tensorValue is sum over a,b of W(a,b).u(q) smul tensor a b. The actual tensorJet is sum over a,b of W(a,b).du(q).smulRight(tensor a b); its direction slot is the genuine Graph covector derivative, so its (p,a,b) basis component is W(a,b).du(q)(e_p). Thus the realization is the whole actual zero/first-order tensor action on those reconstructed inputs, with no symmetry or realization restriction on W beyond membership in the nine Graph inputs. The all-ambient explicit value equation is distinct from this on-cylinder actual-field equation. Boundedness and time gains retain the existing Graph zero trace and derivative carriers, rather than a value-only surrogate. The sign is the positive lower action of DQ; it will be subtracted in L=dt-principal-K, and this statement does not assert that subtraction, construct the principal/time/global operator, establish covariance, or prove a signed global L/P/R identity, contraction or physical flow.
